value.rationale: PASS. The seven-cycle is a canonical unresolved Shannon-capacity channel, and its two-use optimum is a classical calibration point. The recent exact count of 980 leaves open how many genuinely different optimal code geometries that count represents. Reducing all 980 extrema to three explicit natural-isometry types, identifying the unique symmetric type, and providing invariant distance signatures gives a compact equality structure useful for comparing constructions and for symmetry-reduced searches in higher powers. This is a natural complete classification, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a recomputation of the known optimum.
